verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe llmster as LM Studio's headless daemon for servers, cloud instances and CI with no desktop app required. Headless 'Local LLM Service' mode serves completions and embeddings with on-demand model loading, and the `lms` CLI starts and stops the server and loads models. A recent community report praises the headless flow for real tooling; an older comment wishing for a pure daemon mode because the Electron UI had to run appears to predate llmster, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of llmster install and daemon configuration in CI or server pipelines (e.g., service setup, unattended provisioning).
